business.description: Befound Movement Limited (formerly Regency Trust Limited) is a listed company. During FY 2025-26, members approved addition of new object in the memorandum of association with new industrial activity. The company earned total income of Rs. 275 lakhs.

products.name: Supply & Installation of Material
products.note: Revenue from operations entirely from this segment

risks: BSE has imposed penalty for delay in compliance, the company has made an application for waiver
listing fees has not paid due to financial crises faced by the company
Timing is the most important factor while trading. This fluctuates on rapid basis. According to experts most of the time markets have overvalued or undervalued.
Risk evaluation and management of risk is an ongoing process in the company.

Important factors that could make a difference to the company's operations include economic conditions affecting demand/supply and prices, conditions in the domestic and overseas markets in which the company operates/ going to operate, changes in government regulations, tax laws and other statutes and other incidental factors.
